_comment: POST-HOC analyses, specified on 2026-10-13 after the frozen primary analysis (configs/protocol.json) had been completed and reported, in response to a pre-submission review. They add baselines and sensitivity analyses; they do not alter any primary result or any choice in protocol.json. Every post-hoc model uses the frozen splits, inner folds, selection objective, checkpoint/threshold rules, cross-fitting recipe and final seeds of protocol.json.
rationale: Labels are near step functions (median onset 82 s; 9/35 sessions never report discomfort) and 29 of 35 selected configurations of the primary analysis use the exposure feature sets; an exposure-time-only model is therefore the natural minimal baseline.

Time-LR.note: logistic regression on elapsed time only (class weight 5); full C grid

TimeGame-HGB.note: gradient boosting on elapsed time and game (game-specific, non-linear onset curves); same HGB space and budget as the primary analysis

multiplicity: Holm step-down adjustment over the six paired comparisons of E-DDQN with the other primary models, per operating rule (group-bootstrap p-values)
grouping_sensitivity: paired bootstrap resampling sessions (35 units) instead of linkage groups (21 units)
leave-one-group-out jackknife of each model's 5:1 cost and of the paired cost differences
always_alarm_comparison: paired group bootstrap of each model's D1 cost against the always-alarm policy

cost_curves.threshold: for each ratio R, the threshold minimising R*FN+FP on the pooled inner-OOF seed-ensemble scores of each outer fold's development groups (validation only), applied to that outer-test fold
cost_curves.normalisation: test cost divided by the cost of the better trivial policy at the same R (always alarm or never alarm)

review_round_2._comment: Specified on 2026-10-14 after a structured pre-submission review of the manuscript, when all other results were known. Computed only from the saved per-sample predictions and selected configurations; no model is trained or re-tuned and no primary result changes.
review_round_2.within_fold_roc_auc: ROC-AUC computed within each outer-test fold and averaged over folds (and over seeds for the seed-mean value), reported next to the pooled ROC-AUC, which combines the scores of five fold-specific models
review_round_2.group_sign_flip_test: exact two-sided sign-flip permutation test of the pooled D1 cost difference (seed ensembles) with the 21 linkage groups as units: statistic sum_g eps_g D_g / N over all 2^21 sign vectors; E-DDQN vs every other model (Holm over the six primary comparisons) and every model vs always alarming (Holm over the nine models); also the exposure-time baselines versus the random forest
review_round_2.feature_set_association: exploratory: within-fold ROC-AUC (seed mean) of each primary model and outer fold versus whether the selected feature set contains the 11 questionnaire (CSPQ) indicators; deviation from the fold mean over the seven primary models
review_round_2.search_space_sizes: number of distinct configurations in each family's search space (configs/protocol.json), to qualify 'same number of configurations'
review_round_2.search_draw: feature sets among each family's random-search candidates (results/hpo_results.csv) and, for E-DDQN, the lowest validation cost of candidates with and without the questionnaire indicators per outer fold

_later_additions._comment: Recorded on 2026-10-14 for transparency. The keys 'families', 'multiplicity', 'grouping_sensitivity', 'always_alarm_comparison' and 'cost_curves' were committed before the corresponding analyses were run. The analyses listed here were added afterwards without prior commitment; they are reported as post hoc in the paper (limitation iv; Supplementary Sec. S5).
while_writing_up: paired comparisons of the exposure-time baselines with the primary models (cost and ROC-AUC, group bootstrap)
label-dynamics summary (descriptive statistics of the data)
seed-ensemble block of the main results table (descriptive)

search_draw_sensitivity._comment: Specified on 2026-10-14 after all other results were known, in response to the second-round pre-submission review, and committed BEFORE any of these runs. Question: does E-DDQN's result depend on its single random search draw, which offered only 2 exposure-only configurations (DQN: 6)? Every result is reported whatever it shows; no draw is selected; the primary results are not replaced.
search_draw_sensitivity.protocol: identical to configs/protocol.json: same splits, inner folds, training seed for the search (hpo_seed 777), budget (16 configurations), selection rule (pooled inner-OOF minimum 5:1 cost, ties PR-AUC), checkpoint rule, cross-fitting, final seeds 1000-1004 and threshold rules. Perturbation variants are not scored.

variants.name: E-DDQN-draw2
variants.note: second independent random draw of 16 configurations from the full E-DDQN search space

variants.name: DQN-draw2
variants.note: second independent random draw from the full DQN search space

variants.name: E-DDQN-exposure
variants.note: 16 configurations from the E-DDQN space with the feature set fixed to 'exposure' (no questionnaire indicators)

variants.name: DQN-exposure
variants.note: 16 configurations from the DQN space with the feature set fixed to 'exposure'

analysis: per variant: seed-mean D1 5:1 cost, seed-mean pooled ROC-AUC, within-fold ROC-AUC (seed mean), seed-ensemble D1 cost, selected feature set and discount factor per outer fold, and the number of exposure-only candidates in the draw

per pair: seed-ensemble D1 cost difference E-DDQN minus DQN with a 2,000-replicate group bootstrap (95% CI, two-sided p; seed 5) and an exact group sign-flip test; pooled ROC-AUC difference with a group bootstrap (seed 6)

decision_rules.R1_headline: The claim 'E-DDQN does not outperform the standard DQN' is challenged if, in any pair, E-DDQN's seed-ensemble D1 cost is lower than DQN's and the group-bootstrap 95% CI of the difference excludes zero.
decision_rules.R2_draw_dependence: E-DDQN's result is called draw-dependent if, across its three full-space draws, its seed-mean D1 cost spans more than 0.05 or its within-fold ROC-AUC spans more than 0.05.
decision_rules.R3_feature_set: Under the exposure-only restriction: if E-DDQN's within-fold ROC-AUC is within 0.03 of DQN's, the feature-set/search-draw explanation of Section V-G is supported; if it is more than 0.05 below DQN's, that explanation is insufficient and other components of E-DDQN remain plausible contributors; otherwise inconclusive.
